name: OOO BK Olimp (Olimpbet)
note: Legal entity of the Olimpbet bookmaker. Sportclan's review of open company registers (archived June 2024): 97.5% held by OOO Zevs, 2.5% by CEO Sergey Kozyavkin; Zevs's founders, on a parity basis, are Darina Denisova (former president of the bookmakers' self-regulated organisation) and Andrey Petukhov.
